advisories.reason: No patched version exists: every release up to 4.0.7, the latest, is vulnerable (CVE-2026-112366). The ReDoS needs an attacker-supplied glob pattern, and the tools that use picomatch here only run the glob patterns defined in this repository's configs.
advisories.affects: Development tooling only, through devDependencies: tsdown (build), vite and vitest (tests), typescript-eslint (lint) and Metro, via the react-native devDependency. picomatch is not imported by dist/ and is not installed by apps that use the package.
